_comment: Visual vocabulary. storyboard scene.visual.type should be one of these keys (or 'custom'). The validator warns on unknown types; add new types here when you build a reusable pattern. See references/visual-catalog.md for guidance.

kinetic-title.use_when: Opening hook, section headers, a single strong line.

statement.use_when: One claim or takeaway on screen, with a highlighted key phrase.

bullet-build.use_when: 2–4 parallel points built one at a time. Never more than 4 on screen.

stat.use_when: One to three headline numbers that deserve their own moment.

line-chart.use_when: A trend over an ordered x (time, iterations, dose). ≤ 4 series.

comparison.use_when: Two things side by side: before/after, A vs B.

diagram.use_when: Process, pipeline, architecture: boxes and arrows drawn in reading order.

network.use_when: Entities and relations; knowledge graphs; citation webs.

equation.use_when: A formula, or a derivation revealed step by step.

field.use_when: A scalar function over 2D: heatmaps, loss landscapes, densities, PDE snapshots.

surface-3d.use_when: A surface, solid or point cloud where depth matters. Orbit slowly.

code.use_when: Short code (≤ 12 lines) with one line highlighted at a time.

image.use_when: A figure, photo or screenshot from the sources; pan/zoom and annotate.

annotation.use_when: Hand-drawn emphasis layered on another visual.

map.use_when: Geography. Needs local GeoJSON/TopoJSON in assets/.

outro.use_when: Summary, call to action, credits, sources.

custom.use_when: Anything else. Describe it fully in visual.notes.
